sbe:messageSchema.description: Rates platform market data and recording messages

type.name: Symbol
type.description: Exchange symbol, for example ZNZ6, padded with nulls

enum.name: SourceTag
enum.description: Where a recording's data came from

enum.name: AggressorSide
enum.description: Side of the order that took liquidity

enum.name: BookState
enum.description: Whether consumers may trust an instrument's book (FR.MD.03)

sbe:message.name: RecordingHeader
sbe:message.description: First message of every recording. Carries the source tag (CLAUDE.md rule 7)

field.name: startTimeNanos
field.description: Epoch nanoseconds of the first event

field.name: seed
field.description: Random seed used to produce or replay the recording

sbe:message.name: InstrumentDefinition
sbe:message.description: Static definition of one tradable instrument

field.name: contractMultiplier
field.description: Dollars per one full point of price

field.name: tickSize256ths
field.description: Tick size in 1/256 of a point: ZB 8, ZN 4, ZF 2, ZT 1

sbe:message.name: BookUpdate
sbe:message.description: One market by order book event

field.name: seqNum
field.description: Channel sequence number

field.name: priceTicks
field.description: Price in ticks of the instrument

field.name: exchangeTimeNanos
field.description: Venue transact time, epoch nanoseconds

field.name: receiveTimeNanos
field.description: Local receive time, epoch nanoseconds

field.name: seqNum
field.description: Channel sequence number

field.name: priceTicks
field.description: Price in ticks of the instrument

field.name: exchangeTimeNanos
field.description: Venue transact time, epoch nanoseconds

field.name: receiveTimeNanos
field.description: Local receive time, epoch nanoseconds

sbe:message.name: SnapshotFullRefresh
sbe:message.description: Venue snapshot of one instrument's resting orders, sent on the recovery channel (FR.MD.02)

field.name: lastSeqNum
field.description: Channel sequence number of the last incremental included in this snapshot

field.name: transactTimeNanos
field.description: Venue time of the snapshot, epoch nanoseconds

field.name: chunkIndex
field.description: 0 based chunk number, for books too big for one message

group.name: orders
group.description: Resting orders in queue priority order: earlier entries were placed first

sbe:message.name: TopOfBook
sbe:message.description: Best bid and offer after an update. An empty side has the int64 null price (Long.MIN_VALUE) and quantity 0

field.name: sourceSeqNum
field.description: Venue channel sequence number that caused this update

field.name: exchangeTimeNanos
field.description: Venue transact time, epoch nanoseconds

field.name: receiveTimeNanos
field.description: Feed handler receive time, epoch nanoseconds (FR.MD.07)

field.name: publishTimeNanos
field.description: Feed handler publish time, epoch nanoseconds (FR.MD.07)

sbe:message.name: BookDepth
sbe:message.description: Aggregated depth by price level, best first, on its own stream (FR.MD.08)

field.name: sourceSeqNum
field.description: Venue channel sequence number that caused this update

sbe:message.name: BookStatus
sbe:message.description: Published the moment an instrument's book changes trust state (FR.MD.03)

field.name: lastSeqNum
field.description: Last channel sequence number applied to the book

field.name: timeNanos
field.description: Feed handler time of the change, epoch nanoseconds

sbe:message.name: FeedHandlerTrade
sbe:message.description: A venue trade as republished by the feed handler, with its timestamps (FR.MD.07, FR.MD.08)
